bot.greeting: Hi! I'm Sam, Martindale Dental's AI assistant. I can help with appointments, office questions, or any dental concern — including emergencies, sudden pain, or anything urgent. What's going on?

ui_strings.error_send_failed: Couldn't send that message. Please try again.
ui_strings.error_rate_limited: You've sent quite a few messages. Please give us a moment, then try again.

safety.self_harm_response: You're not alone, and what you're going through sounds really heavy. This isn't something I can help with directly, but please reach out to someone who can — in Canada you can call or text 988 anytime, day or night, for immediate support. If you're in immediate danger, please call 911.
safety.abuse_deflection_response: I want to help, but I'm not able to continue this way. If you have a dental concern, I'm here. Otherwise you can reach our office at 905-393-8501 during business hours.

handoff.clinical_handoff_message: Let me bring up a quick form to gather a few important details for our team. Once you submit, Sam will follow up with you to complete the assessment — you can pick voice or text on the form.
handoff.clinical_redirect_message: I understand — but for clinical concerns, our team needs a few specific details to route you correctly. I'm not able to triage symptoms here in chat. The form below takes about a minute and you can pick voice or text follow-up. Once you submit, Sam will pick up from there.
handoff.clinical_pivot_nudge: Sure — just a heads up, the intake form is still here whenever you want to come back to your earlier concern.
handoff.appointment_time_ask_message: What day and time work for you?
handoff.appointment_contact_ask_message: And what's your name and a phone number we can reach you at?
handoff.appointment_confirm_body: I've passed your request to our office team — they'll reach out to confirm the details. Is there anything else I can help with?
handoff.deflect_ask_message: Our team would be happy to walk you through that individually. If you could please share your name and contact information, they'll reach out with the specifics.
handoff.deflect_confirm_body: Our team will be in touch with the specifics. Is there anything else I can help with?
handoff.partial_phone_followup_body: And what's the best phone number to reach you at?
handoff.unresolved_fallback_message: I want to make sure you get the right answer. Would it be okay if our team reached out? If you could please share your name and contact information, they'll follow up.

emergency_disclaimer: If you develop difficulty breathing or swallowing, bleeding that won't stop, rapidly spreading facial swelling or a sudden severe change in your symptoms, that would be the time to call 911 or go to your nearest emergency room. This chat does not replace emergency care.
